response: Yes, non-invasive diagnosis of esophageal varices in patients with compensated hepatic cirrhosis is possible by duplex Doppler ultrasonography. The Spleen-to-Portal Vein velocity ratio index (SPI) has been found to be accurate in predicting the presence or absence of esophageal varices in patients with compensated cirrhosis. This suggests that duplex Doppler ultrasonography can be a useful tool for non-invasive diagnosis and monitoring of esophageal varices in these patients.
